create_qwen2_5_vl_model: create a Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration model instance from a HuggingFace config for multimodal inference
build_vision_transformer: build a Qwen2_5_VisionTransformer to encode image or video pixel values into embeddings
run_vision_encoder: run the vision encoder on pixel values and grid dimensions to produce image embeddings
load_model_weights: load HuggingFace checkpoint weights into a Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration model with QKV and gate_up projection sharding
get_image_features: get image feature embeddings from a list of MultimodalDataItem objects using the vision transformer
